direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale does the most it can to make the world feel like it is in an apocalypse with such a small budget; The direction on a microscale is decent and shows the emotions these characters would go through if they had three days left to live; Storytelling uses the emotions of the situation to really tell the story because there really is not that much plot; It builds tension pretty well as they use the emotions and fear of the situation to create a hectic environment

cast.comments: Everyone plays their role decently well;

story.comments: The concept is pretty simple, as it's an apocalypse movie with the world ending in 3 days, following a family during this time period; The plot structure is pretty simple; Character writing is fine

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is standard; the symbolism is pretty good, as it touches on how the world would react to it ending in 3 days, touching on personal and familial anxiety about the situation; the foreshadowing is decent, considering you know what will happen by the end of the movie

score.comments: Helps with the tone and tension of scenes

cinematography.comments: Feels very 2000s with its low-budget, apocalypse feel as it feels like it took a lot of inspiration from 28 Days Later

editing.comments: Feels very 2000s with its low-budget, apocalypse feel as it feels like it took a lot of inspiration from 28 Days Later

sound.comments: Feels very 2000s with its low-budget, apocalypse feel, as it feels like it took a lot of inspiration from 28 Days Later

visual_effects.comments: Uses a lot of movie magic and low-budget CGI to make the most of what they can on such a shoestring budget

production_design.comments: Uses a lot of movie magic to make this world feel like it is ending on such a low budget

makeup.comments: Use a lot of movie magic to make this world feel like it is ending on such a low budget

review.pacing: Pacing feels on the faster side in each scene to make this movie hectic, but the movie feels pretty slow on a macroscale because there isn't that much of a plot to go through
review.tone: Tone is very low-budget apocalyptic and takes a lot of inspiration from 28 Days Later
review.overall: Overall, a decent apocalypse movie that uses the emotions of the situation to drive the minimal plot, shot on a shoestring budget
